text:
maya (PM): quick sync — I pushed a draft PRD for the console tracing + retention UX. Need alignment on acceptance criteria and what we gate for initial launch. link: https://rwd/internal/prd/trace-retention

zoe (Design): skimmed it. main UX questions: where does retention config live (per-org vs per-dataset), and how do we surface sampling vs full-trace costs in the UI?

raj (Eng): from infra side, per-dataset retention is harder but doable. per-org requires metadata changes and a migration for existing datasets. cost: storing full traces x retention_days grows linearly; we should default to sampled traces and make full-trace storage opt-in.

eli (SRE): edge cases: query timeouts when a user requests a long time range + full-trace results, and alerting when retention storage approaches capacity. Also we need a fallback when ES/OLAP shard is down — errors should show a friendly UX message (not a stacktrace).

maya (PM): proposed scope for MVP (must-have):
- retention slider (7/30/90 days presets) at org level with per-dataset override
- sampling policy UI (p95 latency vs sampled TTL) with simple presets
- dashboard: traces by service, error rate, avg latency
- acceptance criteria: all features behind an opt-in feature flag; e2e test demonstrating retention change takes effect within 10 minutes; UX shows estimated storage delta when user changes retention

andrew (Product): sounds reasonable. ask from sales: some customers want per-route retention and export hooks to S3. both are nice-to-have for MVP. recommend we mark per-route retention as "beta" (post-launch).

sarah (CS): big customer asks: 1) retention by team (not just org), 2) retention export to S3/GCS, 3) audit log of retention changes. If we do org + per-dataset override now, CS can patch customers with a documented workaround until team-level is available.

doc-bot: updated PRD: https://rwd/internal/prd/trace-retention (v2) — added acceptance criteria and rollout notes

raj (Eng): implementation notes:
```
- API: PATCH /v1/orgs/:org_id/retention { dataset_id?, retention_days }
- DB: add retention_days to dataset_meta (nullable)
- Worker: daily compaction job to mark traces outside window for deletion
- Queries: enforce retention filter at query planner level
```
Two open infra decisions: soft-delete vs hard delete for traces, and compaction window (immediate vs 24h batch).

eli (SRE): prefer soft-delete + TTL on the storage backend for safety. compaction can be batched 1x/day to reduce IO. Also we should expose a retention_usage metric per-org for console billing views.

zoe (Design): UX acceptance checklist suggestion:
- retention control reachable in Org settings and in Dataset settings
- changing retention shows a confirmation modal with "estimated storage impact" and a short explanation of sampling vs full-trace
- when retention < 30 days show inline help: "shorter retention reduces costs but may limit debugging"
- error states mocked (backend down, permission denied)
I can mock screens by EOD tomorrow.

maya (PM): decision calls:
- default: org-level 30 days + per-dataset override (opt-in) — AGREED
- deletion strategy: soft-delete + TTL — AGREED
- export to S3: OUT for MVP, add RFC for post-launch
- per-route/team retention: POST-LAUNCH, target Q2 milestone

andrew (Product): for launch criteria add: GA docs, CS runbook, and two pilot customers onboarded with Dedicated/Demo orgs.

raj (Eng): rough engineering estimate: 3 sprints for core API + worker + console hooks; 1 sprint for e2e and rollouts. Risk: index migration if we add retention on old datasets.

maya (PM): open questions for next week:
- quota policy: do we enforce retention-related storage quotas now or leave for billing integration? (proposal: show estimate only, enforce later)
- telemetry: which telemetry events do we need to drive quality alerts? (retention_change, export_requested, compaction_run)

eli (SRE): recommend we add "retention_usage" and "compaction_errors" to infra metrics now.

sarah (CS): I'll pull the customer list for pilots and notify two customers who requested retention control.

zoe (Design): will post mockups and an accessibility check in the PRD thread by EOD tomorrow.

maya (PM): thanks all — action items:
- zoe: mocks (EOD)
- raj: API + worker design doc (mid next week)
- eli: metrics + compaction run plan (Tue)
- sarah: pilot customer commitments (Thu)
- andrew: update launch checklist with GA docs + runbook (Fri)
I'll update PRD with decisions and mark features behind feature flag. :thumbsup:

raj (Eng): noted. proposing feature flag name: feat:trace-retention-v2

maya (PM): perfect, pushing that in. If there are any objections, call them out here. Otherwise I'll tag for review and send to eng-planning for sprint allocation.

andrew (Product): no objections. go ahead. :rocket:

(END)
